title: A single illegal character in any field truncates confCons.xml to 0 bytes, and the app reports a successful save
author: eran132
body_snippet:
## Summary

If serializing the connection tree throws for any reason, the serializer returns an **empty string**, and that empty string is written over `confCons.xml`. The user is told the save succeeded. The only error goes to the log file, not the UI.

A single XML-illegal control character in any persisted field is enough — the kind of thing that arrives from a terminal copy-paste, a CSV/AD import, or a pasted hostname.

## Reproduction

Driving the real `XmlConnectionsSaver` on `v1.78.2-dev`...
